scope: Require proxy DXF bit-sized payloads to occupy exactly ceil(declared bits / 8) bytes, including rejection of surplus whole bytes when the declared bit count is byte-aligned.

implementation.productionChange: validateProxyDxfPayloads compares each declared bit-sized byte vector against the exact ceiling byte count; the former alternative accepting one extra byte was removed.
generatedCases: Existing 9-bit ASCII/binary entity and object payload positives retain exactly two data bytes.
New ASCII/binary entity and object cases declare 16 bits but provide three bytes and are rejected before typed or raw callback publication.
Existing 16-bit/two-byte retained-budget object controls remain positive.
